Firefighters from the Ghana National Fire Service (GNFS) have averted a potential disaster after swiftly extinguishing a fire involving a tanker at Naagamni Filling Station at Nyohini in Tamale.
According to a post shared on Facebook by GNFS, the fire, which involved a tanker with registration number GS 8225-10, broke out at about 12:10 p.m. while the vehicle was parked at the filling station.
Personnel from the Northern Regional Headquarters Sub-station spotted the fire and immediately dispatched a fire appliance to the scene.
The crew promptly commenced firefighting operations, bringing the blaze under control before successfully extinguishing it.
The intervention prevented the tanker from being completely destroyed and averted a potentially major disaster at the filling station.
Preliminary investigations by the Service revealed that the tanker had developed a mechanical fault and was undergoing repairs when the fire broke out.
